name: Marble Legends
description: Unveil the Marble Legends for Flux! Transport your creations to the timeless beauty of ancient stone with the "Marble Legends" Flux LoRA! Imagine intricate bas-relief panels that tell stories of myth, history, and heroism, or majestic, fully realized marble portraits with lifelike precision. These creations evoke the spirit of master artisans who could breathe life into cold stone, crafting characters with strikingly detailed muscles, flowing robes, and faces that capture the depth of emotion in smooth, polished marble.
